mission.title: Connecting every business with the right person for the job
mission.p1: Every year, many industries in Greece face a huge staffing problem. Thousands of jobs stay unfilled while thousands of workers search desperately for work. StaffNow bridges that gap with technology, speed and simplicity.
mission.p2: We believe in a world where finding a job or finding staff is as easy as a swipe on your phone. That's what we build every day.

story.title: From an idea in Thessaloniki to the platform reshaping the job market
story.p1: In the summer of 2024, a team with experience in staffing and technology met in Thessaloniki with a simple observation: hiring still runs through generic listings platforms — tools that treat every profession the same way, without understanding the real needs of either businesses or workers.
story.p2: The business owner posts a listing and waits blindly: not knowing who will see it, when, or whether it fits their needs. Dozens of irrelevant CVs pile up in their inbox, and the listing gets buried among thousands of others. Meanwhile, the worker sends ten CVs and hears back from two — if that. A position that needs covering now ends up filled weeks later. Or never.
story.p3: StaffNow was created to close that gap. Instead of static listings and blind applications, workers and businesses discover each other through swipe-based matching: you «like» the ones you're interested in, and as soon as there's mutual interest, the chat opens. No waiting, no blind applications — just real matches, in real time, with AI that suggests candidates and jobs based on the profile.
story.p4: Today StaffNow is open to businesses and workers from every industry — from food service and hospitality to retail, services, logistics and manual trades — starting in Thessaloniki and expanding across Greece. We keep improving the platform every day, with one goal: hiring should happen as fast as it truly needs to.

header.title: Frequently Asked Questions
header.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about StaffNow

0.a: StaffNow is the first swipe-style matching platform in Greece. It connects businesses in every industry (food service, retail, logistics, health, construction and more) with reliable workers through a fast, easy-to-use matching system. Beyond permanent job listings, StaffNow also has urgent shifts for last-minute cover and small jobs (TaskNow) for everyday tasks.

1.q: Can I talk by video within the platform?
1.a: Yes, and it's completely free for everyone — no subscription needed. As soon as there's a match, a camera icon appears in the conversation: one tap starts a video call inside StaffNow, with nothing to install and no one giving out their phone number. Video and audio go directly from device to device. One thing to note: the call only rings if the other person has StaffNow open on their device at that moment. If it's closed, they'll get a notification — it's a good idea to arrange it by message first.

2.a: They're everyday small jobs — moving furniture, cleaning, assembly, dog walking, shopping, minor repairs. You post for free what you need done, how much you're paying and where, and you receive offers. You pick whoever you like and talk within the platform. Your exact address is never published: the map only shows the wider area. In categories that require a licence (electrical, plumbing, gas, refrigeration), no offer is allowed without declaring a licence. Until there are enough real listings, you'll see clearly marked examples so you can see how it works — these don't accept offers and disappear on their own.

3.a: They're listings for covering a specific shift that's happening right now — e.g. someone left and you need a person tonight. They have a start date and time, appear separately from permanent listings, and stop showing once their time has passed, so no dead listings linger in the list.

4.a: After you create a profile, the platform shows you relevant profiles (job listings if you're a worker, candidates if you're a business). You show interest with the "✓ Interested" button or by swiping right, and pass with a swipe left. When both sides are interested, a match is created: a conversation opens and you can talk by message or by video call. StaffNow is a professional platform, not a dating one — that's why interest is shown with a ✓ rather than a heart.

5.a: Yes! Signing up and creating a profile is completely free for both workers and businesses. Workers use the platform for free, with no limit on swipes. Premium (a one-off €4.99, paid once for good) is optional and adds extra features. Businesses have subscription plans.

6.q: What plans are there and what do they cost?
6.a: For workers: free use, with an optional one-off Premium at €4.99. For businesses: Free (€0) to try out with one listing, Starter (€29/month), Pro (€79/month) for teams that hire continuously, and Elite (€149/month) for larger organisations. There's also Pro (Founding) at €39/month: the same features as Pro at a locked-in price, for the first 100 businesses to take it. Business plan prices are excluding VAT (24% is added to the payment). Paying annually gets you 9 months for the price of 12 (25% discount). You can also buy credit packs without a monthly subscription. All plans can be cancelled at any time, with no penalties.

7.q: How do I make my listing stand out?
7.a: With promotion: the listing rises to the top of the lists for 7 days and gets a "Promoted" badge. It also shows to visitors without an account, i.e. on "Find a job" and the homepage, where most people look. It costs 5 credits and is available on the Pro, Pro (Founding) and Elite plans — not on Starter. It doesn't apply to urgent shifts, since they only last a few hours and the credits would go to waste.

8.a: On three levels. Email is confirmed with a link we send you. You can upload your ID from settings, and a person from our team checks it. For mobile: right now we don't yet send SMS, so the number is recorded as "declared" and confirmed by us — it never shows to anyone as verified until the check is genuinely done. We never show a verification badge for something that hasn't been checked.

9.a: The security of your data is our priority. We use state-of-the-art encryption (TLS/SSL) for all communications, we fully follow the GDPR, and we never share your data with third parties without your explicit consent. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.

10.q: Which areas is it available in?
10.a: StaffNow is available across all of Greece. We cover the islands (Santorini, Mykonos, Crete, Rhodes, Corfu and more), the mainland (Athens, Thessaloniki, Chalkidiki and more) and every region of the country. We're planning expansion into more countries in the future.

11.q: How can I cancel my subscription?
11.a: You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. Cancellation takes effect from the next billing cycle. There are no cancellation penalties or hidden fees. If you cancel, your account automatically returns to the free version.

1.a: During sign-up you'll see two options: "Worker" and "Business". If you're looking for a job, choose Worker. If you're looking for staff, choose Business. This choice determines what you see on the platform.

s1.title: 1. What Cookies Are
s1.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit our website. They help us make the platform work properly, keep it more secure, and give you a better experience.

s2.title: 2. Types of Cookies We Use
s2.s21p: These are absolutely necessary for the platform to function. Without them, the website cannot work properly. They include authentication, security and session-preference cookies.

table.row2purpose: Your choices in this consent banner (essential)
table.row4purpose: Traffic statistics — ONLY if you agree to "Statistics"
table.row4duration: Until you opt out / end of visit
table.row5purpose: What you've already seen/answered, so we don't ask again (essential)

s2.s22p: These help us remember your preferences (language, location, display settings) for a more personalised experience. They don't collect information that can identify you.
s2.s23p: These let us understand how you use the platform (pages you visit, time spent). The data is anonymous and helps us continuously improve the Service.
s2.s24p: These are used to show you relevant ads within and outside the platform. They are only placed with your explicit consent.

s3.title: 3. Managing Cookies
s3.p1: You can manage your cookie preferences at any time. On your first visit, you'll see a banner with your choices. You can also change cookie settings through your browser. Note that disabling certain cookies may affect the platform's functionality.

s4.title: 4. Third-Party Cookies
s4.p1: We do not use Google Analytics or advertising cookies. Only during checkout does Stripe's payment page set its own security cookies, which are subject to Stripe's privacy policy. If you sign in via Google, Google's policy applies to the sign-in process.

s5.title: 5. Policy Updates
s5.p1: This policy may be updated from time to time. In the event of material changes, we will notify you via a banner on the platform. The date of the last update is shown at the top of this page.

s6.title: 6. Contact
s6.p1: For questions about our use of cookies, contact us at privacy@staffnow.gr.

s1.title: 1. Introduction
s1.p1: The protection of your personal data is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store and protect your data when you use the StaffNow platform, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and Greek law.

s2.title: 2. Data Controller
s2.p1: The data controller for your data is the company StaffNow, headquartered in Thessaloniki, Greece. For data protection matters, you can contact us at privacy@staffnow.gr.

s3.title: 3. Data We Collect
s3.li1: Full name, email, phone number, role (worker/business).
s3.li2: Experience, skills, languages, location, availability, profile photo.
s3.li3: Actions on the platform (swipes, matches, messages), access times, device.
s3.li4: Billing information (processed by a certified payment provider).
s3.li5: IP address, browser type, operating system.

s5.title: 5. Legal Basis for Processing
s5.p1: Processing is based on: performance of a contract (providing the Service), consent (marketing, cookies), legitimate interest (security, improvement), and legal obligation (tax records).

s6.title: 6. Data Disclosure
s6.p1: We do not sell your data. We may share data with: other users (only the data shown on your public profile — email, phone number and CV only after a mutual match), public authorities (where required by law), and the following providers who process data on our behalf:
s6.li1: (US/EU) — platform hosting, database, file storage, network security.
s6.li2: (EU/US) — card payments. We never see or store your card details.
s6.li3: (US) — only when you use the artificial-intelligence features (e.g. CV generation, candidate suggestions). Only the profile or listing data you ask it to process is sent.
s6.li4: (US) — only if you choose to sign in via Google.
s6.li5: — for the emails and verification codes we send you.
s6.p2: For providers outside the EU, transfers are made under the European Commission's standard contractual clauses or an adequacy decision (Data Privacy Framework).

s7.title: 7. Data Retention
s7.p1: We retain your data for as long as your account is active. After your account is deleted, your data is deleted within 30 days, unless a legal obligation requires it to be kept longer.

s8.title: 8. Your Rights
s8.p1: Under the GDPR, you have the right to:
s8.li3: Erasure of data (the «right to be forgotten»).
s8.p2: To exercise your rights, contact privacy@staffnow.gr.

s9.title: 9. Data Security
s9.p1: We apply appropriate technical and organisational security measures, including TLS/SSL encryption, access controls, regular backups and security audits.

s10.title: 10. Contact
s10.p1: For questions about this privacy policy, contact us: email privacy@staffnow.gr. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: By accessing and using the StaffNow platform (the «Service»), you agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with any of these terms, please do not use the Service.

s2.title: 2. Description of Service
s2.p1: StaffNow is a digital platform that facilitates connections between businesses and workers across every industry through a matching system. The Service is not an employment agency and does not intervene in the employment relationships between businesses and workers.

s3.title: 3. Registration & Accounts
s3.p1: Creating an account is required to use certain features. You warrant that the information you provide is accurate and up to date. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity carried out through your account. Creating multiple accounts or using false information is prohibited.

s4.title: 4. Use of the Platform
s4.p1: You may not use the platform for purposes contrary to the law or these terms, including without limitation: posting false or misleading listings, sending unsolicited messages (spam), collecting other users' personal data, interfering with the platform's operation, and any other unlawful or non-compliant use.

s5.title: 5. User Content
s5.p1: Users are solely responsible for the content they post on the platform. You grant StaffNow a non-exclusive licence to use your content for the purposes of operating the Service. We reserve the right to remove content that violates these terms.

s6.title: 6. Subscriptions & Payments
s6.p1: Certain features of the Service require a subscription. Prices are listed in Euros and include VAT. Billing occurs automatically each month. You may cancel your subscription at any time, but no refund is provided for the current billing period.

s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
s7.p1: The Service is provided «as is». StaffNow does not guarantee that the Service will be uninterrupted or error-free. We are not liable for any damages arising from the use or inability to use the Service, including damages arising from employment relationships formed through the platform.

s8.title: 8. Termination
s8.p1: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate an account that violates these terms. You may delete your account at any time through the settings.

s9.title: 9. Changes to These Terms
s9.p1: We reserve the right to modify these terms. In the event of material changes, we will notify you by email or through the platform. Continued use of the Service after notice constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.

s10.title: 10. Governing Law
s10.p1: These terms are governed by Greek law. Any dispute arising shall be resolved by the competent courts of Athens. For any question regarding these Terms of Use, please contact us at info@staffnow.gr.
